verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.supermemory.ai that indexes the docs as markdown pages. The docs also include a dedicated agents page offering a docs-search remote MCP, an official skill so agents use real endpoints instead of hallucinating APIs, and an `npx supermemory setup` CLI flow. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually using these docs, and no evidence of a full-content llms-full.txt variant.
